name: Turkey or Chicken Pies
description: Individual or large pies filled with turkey or chicken, vegetables, and a creamy sauce, topped with a homemade pastry crust or biscuits.
recipeYield: Multiple individual pies or 1 large pie

recipeInstructions.text: Melt margarine with salt and pepper over low heat. Add flour and gradually add broth, cooking until smooth.
Sauté chopped onion and celery until tender.
Boil carrots until thoroughly cooked.
Mix cooked carrots with peas and the sauce made earlier.
For the pastry, mix flour, salt, and baking powder with butter. Add milk to form a dough.
Fill small pans or a large pie plate with the turkey or chicken mixture and top with pastry crust or biscuits.
Bake until the crust is golden brown.

keywords: turkey pie, chicken pie, savory pastry, comfort food

_similar.name: Turkey A La King
_similar.description: A creamy turkey dish made with mushrooms, celery, and green pepper, served over toast or rice.

recipeInstructions.text: In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add mushrooms, onion, celery, and green pepper. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Remove vegetables from skillet with a slotted spoon and set aside.
In the same skillet, blend flour into the butter to make a roux. Gradually add chicken broth and milk, stirring constantly.
Bring mixture to a boil and cook for 2 minutes, or until it thickens.
Add reserved turkey and vegetables to the sauce. Heat through.
Serve over hot toast, biscuits, or rice.

_similar.keywords: turkey a la king, creamy turkey, mushrooms, celery, green pepper

_similar.name: Chili Turkey
_similar.description: A hearty chili turkey dish made with ground turkey, kidney beans, and whole wheat spaghetti.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook, stirring to coarsely crumble until no longer pink, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, tomato paste, broth, cinnamon, cumin, salt, coriander, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
Partially cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender and the broth is slightly thickened.
Meanwhile, pour the beans (with juice) into a microwaveable bowl. Microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through. Drain and cover to keep warm.
Cook the pasta as directed.
Place pasta on a plate, ladle chili over pasta, and top with beans, then with cheese.

_similar.keywords: chili turkey, ground turkey, kidney beans, whole wheat spaghetti

_similar.name: Hamburger Pie
_similar.description: A savory pie made with ground beef, green beans, and tomato soup, topped with a layer of mashed potatoes and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat 4 Tbsp oil in a pan and brown the sliced onion.
Add the hamburger, salt, and pepper to the pan and brown the meat.
Add the cooked green beans and tomato soup to the meat mixture and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with warm milk and beaten egg.
Spoon the mashed potatoes in mounds over the top of the meat mixture in the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Hearty Chicken Pot Pie
_similar.description: A comforting chicken pot pie filled with vegetables and chicken in a creamy sauce, topped with a pie crust.
recipeIngredient: 1 cup mixed vegetables (corn, carrots, leeks, mushrooms)
1 cup red wine or soya sauce

recipeInstructions.text: In a saucepan, simmer the mixed vegetables in chicken stock for 5 minutes.
In another saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Whisk in milk and red wine (or soya sauce). Bring to a boil and thicken.
Add cooked chicken, tarragon, lemon rind, salt, and pepper to the sauce. Mix well.
Pour the filling into unbaked pie shells.
Cover with top crust and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot. Note that the filling freezes well for later use.

_similar.keywords: chicken pot pie, comfort food, savory pie

_similar.name: Chicken and Cheese Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting chicken and rice casserole topped with a crunchy corn flake and celery mixture.
recipeIngredient: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Blend together the chicken, rice, cream soup, milk, cheese, and onion in a large bowl.
Put the mixture into a buttered casserole dish.
Stir the corn flake crumbs into melted butter, then mix in the chopped celery.
Cook until the celery is hot.
Spread the corn flake and celery mixture over the chicken mixture.
Bake in a 375°F oven for about ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, cheesy rice bake, comfort food
